title: PORT-BRANCH-parked-claude-public-release-split: carry parked/claude/public-release-split onto main
body:

**Trigger:** branch `parked/claude/public-release-split` at 7e9844e0a3 holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: agents/PROJECT-INSTRUCTIONS.md, docs/CONFIDENTIALITY.md)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried parked/claude/public-release-split
**Status:** closed

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 2 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried parked/claude/public-release-split

**Evidence:** Obsolete: the branch records the 2026-11-11 plan (repos private, no patent, ultrastable repo not released); main supersedes it (all repos public since 2026-11-15, LICENSE USL-1.0, docs/CONFIDENTIALITY.md status line citing NO-PATENT-1), so porting would regress it.
